pooling: attention-mask mean over tokens, then L2 normalize (done in numpy; the ONNX graph is the BERT backbone only, output last_hidden_state)

model.onnx.note: FP32 BERT backbone exported by HF optimum; inputs input_ids/attention_mask/token_type_ids, single output last_hidden_state (n, seq, 384). Pooling + normalization are NOT baked in and are reproduced in the embedder.

tokenizer.json.note: fast (Rust tokenizers) tokenizer; loaded with truncation max_length=128 and dynamic right padding. The tokenizer config advertises 512, but the sentence-transformer contract (sentence_bert_config.json) is 128.

license_note: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is released by the sentence-transformers project under Apache-2.0. Redistribution with attribution is permitted; the ~470 MB FP32 model.onnx + tokenizer.json are kept out of git (weights doctrine) and published as an immutable GitHub asset release, then sha256-verified before being baked into the app image. No Hugging Face account, token, or network access is needed at install or runtime.
equivalence: Correctness is a measured 3-model-independent contract, not reasoning: tests/parity/test_text_embedding.py asserts per-vector cosine >= 0.9999 for the ONNX path vs reference vectors generated once in a dev-only sentence-transformers environment (torch never enters the app closure). Regenerate the references with tools/generate_text_embedding_references.py.
regeneration: download onnx/model.onnx + tokenizer.json at the pinned upstream_revision, verify the sha256s above, and publish a NEW asset release (minilm-onnx-v2, ...) together with an updated provenance file, Dockerfile sha ARGs, the *_RELEASE env in release.yml, and (if the tokenizer sha changed) the .gitleaks.toml allowlist entry for its new value — assets under a given tag are immutable.
